settings.content: Date-switched offer messaging, UK time, checked on Shopify's clock and the visitor's device. The open window's message is the first announcement and the offer box on product pages. settings.content: A line with a thin progress bar in the cart drawer and cart page. Display only: set up the matching discount in Shopify (Discounts).

settings.label: Discount text
settings.info: Fills [discount] in the messages below.

settings.label: Phase 1: end line
settings.info: Small line under the bar. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Phase 1: name
settings.info: For the product page offer ticker.

settings.label: Starts (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, UK time)
settings.info: Phase 1 shows until this minute, phase 2 from it, on each visitor's own clock. Leave empty for phase 1 only.

settings.label: Phase 2: end line
settings.info: Small line under the bar. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Phase 2: name
settings.info: For the product page offer ticker.

settings.label: Bundle offer starts (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, UK time)
settings.info: No longer switches the bundle offer on by itself: it shows only while Theme settings > SixthGear: Buy 2 offer > Show Buy 2 offer is on.

settings.label: Bundle offer ends (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, UK time)
settings.info: Leave empty for no end date.

settings.label: Bundle: 1 print in the cart
settings.default: Add 2 more prints to get your 3rd half price

settings.label: Bundle: 2 prints
settings.default: Add 1 more print to get it half price

settings.label: Phases 1 and 2
settings.info: [name], [discount], [threshold] and [ends] come from the phase settings above. Shown on products that count towards the offer (not framed prints).

settings.label: Bundle offer (phase 3)
settings.default: Buy 3 prints · your 3rd is half price
settings.info: Shown from the bundle start on products that count towards it.

settings.label: Product tag that counts
settings.info: Cart items whose product has this tag count towards the spend (any case; sale-eligible works too). Products tagged framed never count.

settings.label: Fallback collection (handle)
settings.info: Only for products without the tag above: items in this collection count too. Leave empty to use the tag alone.

settings.label: Ends (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, UK time)
settings.info: The last minute it shows; hidden from the next minute on each visitor's own clock. Leave empty for no end.

settings.label: Message under the spend
settings.default: Add [amount] more of unframed prints to get [discount]
settings.info: [amount] is what's still needed.

settings.label: Message once reached
settings.default: You've unlocked [discount]. It's applied at checkout.

settings.content: One small line under the price on unframed product pages (prints that count towards the cart offer). Product prices always show their real price; the offer is taken off at checkout.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Black Friday: 25% off unframed prints when you spend £50 · Ends Mon 30 Nov

settings.label: Last day to show it (YYYY-MM-DD)
settings.info: UK date. Hidden automatically from the next day. Leave empty to keep it until you switch it off.

settings.label: Show express checkout buttons on product page
settings.info: Off hides "Buy with Apple Pay" / "More payment options" under Add to cart on product pages. The cart and checkout keep their express buttons.

settings.label: Payment icons
settings.default: visa, master, apple_pay, paypal, klarna, shopify_pay
settings.info: Shopify payment type names, in order, separated by commas. Only methods enabled in Settings > Payments are shown.

settings.label: Line under the icons
settings.info: Leave empty to show the icons only.

settings.label: Small print (optional)
settings.info: For any wording Klarna or PayPal require when you mention paying in instalments.

settings.label: Show featured review
settings.info: Hidden until both a photo and a quote are set.

settings.label: Quote
settings.info: A real customer's words, as they wrote them.

settings.label: Name
settings.info: For example: Richard B., verified buyer

settings.label: Link text
settings.info: Scrolls to the reviews further down the page. Leave empty to hide the link.

settings.label: Maker line
settings.default: Designed in Bristol by a car enthusiast · Printed in the UK
settings.info: Leave empty to hide.

settings.content: Framed prints: frame details (under What you get)

settings.label: Show frame details on framed prints
settings.info: Framed prints are products tagged framed or with Framed in the title, as in the collection grids.

settings.label: Text before the email
settings.info: Leave the email empty to hide the line.

settings.label: Reply time (optional)
settings.info: For example: We usually reply within a day. Only add a time you can keep to.

settings.content: Buy 2 prints, get the 3rd half price, on unframed prints. Display only: set up the matching automatic discount in Shopify (Discounts) before switching this on. While on, the cart progress line counts unframed prints instead of showing the spend offer.

settings.label: Product page: title
settings.default: Buy 2 prints, get the 3rd half price

settings.label: Product page: line under the title
settings.default: Applies to unframed prints. Discount added automatically at checkout.

settings.label: Product page: link to Complete the garage
settings.info: Scrolls to the Complete the garage section. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Complete the garage: line under the heading
settings.default: Add 2 more unframed prints and get your 3rd half price.

settings.content: Cart progress messages: Theme settings > SixthGear: cart spend offer > Bundle: 1 print / 2 prints / 3 or more prints.
A line just above Add to cart on product pages (not on custom posters, which have their own cut-off).

settings.label: Text
settings.default: The gift for the car lover.
settings.info: The first sentence shows a little bolder. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Last day to show it (YYYY-MM-DD)
settings.info: UK date. Hidden automatically from the next day.

settings.content: Review sections and the review line under the price show once the store has this many real reviews in Judge.me (1 = as soon as there's one). Nothing is ever made up: the numbers come from Judge.me.

settings.label: Review sections (section IDs)
settings.info: The template section IDs to hide until then, separated by commas.

settings.label: Product review widget section (section ID)
settings.info: Hidden on products that have no reviews of their own.

settings.content: "Order by … for Christmas delivery" under the delivery estimate on product pages and in the cart. Shown only while a date is set, up to and including that day (UK). Not on custom posters, which have their own cut-off in the delivery estimate.

settings.label: Christmas last order date (YYYY-MM-DD)
settings.info: e.g. 2026-12-16. Leave empty to show nothing. From the next day, the delivery estimate on product pages switches to its "too late for Christmas" message until 24 Dec.

settings.label: Wording
settings.info: [date] becomes the date above, e.g. Wed 16 Dec.

settings.label: Collections kept out of search results
settings.info: Collection handles, separated by commas. They stay published and work as normal, but ask search engines not to list them (noindex).

settings.label: Show the second image on hover
settings.info: Off: a product card keeps its first image when hovered. Applies to every product card (collections, search, recommendations, product grids).

settings.label: Car makes
settings.default: Porsche, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, BMW, Mercedes-AMG, Mercedes-Benz, Mercedes, Audi, Volkswagen, Nissan, Honda, Toyota, Mazda, Subaru, Mitsubishi, Ford, Aston Martin, Jaguar, Lotus, Bugatti, Pagani, Koenigsegg, Alfa Romeo, Lancia, Chevrolet, Dodge, Renault, Peugeot
settings.info: Separated by commas, most specific first. The small make label on product cards, product pages and Pick your garage: the first of these found in a print's title, then its tags (a product's custom.make metafield wins).

settings.label: Models and their makes
settings.default: Carrera GT=Porsche, 911=Porsche, 959=Porsche, 930=Porsche, 964=Porsche, 918=Porsche, GT3=Porsche, Chiron=Bugatti, EB110=Bugatti, GT-R=Nissan, R34=Nissan, Supra=Toyota, Civic=Honda, Golf=Volkswagen, MX-5=Mazda, Impreza=Subaru, Countach=Lamborghini, Murcielago=Lamborghini, Revuelto=Lamborghini, F40=Ferrari, LaFerrari=Ferrari, 812=Ferrari, M2=BMW, M3=BMW, M4=BMW, M140i=BMW, RS6=Audi, 720S=McLaren, P1=McLaren
settings.info: For prints whose title names only the model: Model=Make, separated by commas. Checked after the makes above. Prints that match nothing (e.g. circuits) show no make.

settings.label: Collections that list framed prints
settings.info: Collection handles, separated by commas. Framed prints (tag framed) are left out of every other listing; these collections, and any with "framed" in the handle (not "unframed"), show them.

settings.content: A tag on one size button. Use it only for a choice that genuinely sells the most.

settings.label: Tag the middle size
settings.info: Off by default: only tag a size as most popular if your order data shows it. On products with 3 or more sizes, the middle one.

settings.label: Tag this option value instead
settings.info: Exact value name as in Shopify, e.g. 16x24 (Vertical). Only use this if your order data shows it's the best seller. Leave empty for no tag.
